name: FAROE-SHETLAND CHANNEL
description: Three opposing surface combatants are moving south through the Faroe–Shetland Channel. Three NATO escorts and a maritime patrol detachment at RAF Lossiemouth cover the passage. Prevent any combatant from reaching its marked exit during an eight-hour watch; destroying the surface group also completes the mission. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

map.anchor_note: World coordinates are nautical miles about this point; one minute of latitude is one mile and longitude is scaled by the cosine of the anchor latitude.
map.chart_note: Natural Earth 1:10m · local projection · no depth data

objectives.text: Deny the channel for eight hours, or neutralize all three surface combatants. Any ship reaching its exit loses the mission.

forces: NATO: 1 destroyer, 2 frigates, Lossiemouth patrol det  ·  Russia: 1 cruiser, 1 frigate, 1 destroyer
force_note: Fictional 2027 deployment; established platform fits. Reduced air detachments; no claim of actual readiness or deployment.
